deployments_detail.use: Aim (Aim1) — TDK's original in-house AI data-analysis platform for materials informatics (MI). Performs high-speed AI image analysis of magnetic/dielectric materials (grain and particle shape/size measurement) and disseminates data-analysis technologies company-wide to accelerate materials R&D. Launched for internal use in April 2023 after trials since 2019, initially in Japanese research divisions with planned expansion to more domestic and overseas sites. [TDK in-house (Aim)]

SensorGPT — uses generative AI, physics-based modeling, signal processing and simulation to synthesize sensor data at scale, cutting the data-collection effort needed to train Edge AI models (applicable to IoT, wearables, physical AI). Announced May 2026. [TDK (SensorGPT)]
deployments_detail.value: 90% similarity between synthetic and real-world sensor data

deployments_detail.use: TDK SensEI edgeRX Vision — an AI-powered optical defect-detection system that analyzes product images/video to detect defects as small as 1mm x 0.5mm at up to 2,000 parts/minute, enhancing existing AOI hardware to reduce false positives and unnecessary machine stoppages across electronics, pharma, and food/beverage manufacturing. Launched July 15, 2025. [TDK SensEI (edgeRX Vision)]
deployments_detail.value: detects defects down to 1mm x 0.5mm at up to 2,000 parts/minute

deployments_detail.use: TDK SensEI edgeRX — Edge AI platform for real-time industrial machine-health monitoring and predictive maintenance using AI/ML on gyroscope, accelerometer and other sensor data to detect anomalies and predict equipment failures. Named a 2026 Industrial IoT Product of the Year by IoT Evolution. [TDK SensEI (edgeRX)]
SensorGPT: Generative AI for Edge AI Development Acceleration [SensorGPT]

Qeexo AutoML — automated machine-learning platform (acquired by TDK in 2023) for building and one-click-deploying TinyML models on edge/sensor devices; supports sensor data collection/visualization, automated model building and multiple ML algorithms, optimized for ultra-low power/memory. Now offered as a TDK SensEI product. [Qeexo AutoML (TDK-group), hosted on AWS]

TDK Generative AI (TDK GenAI) — an internal generative-AI service platform with an API gateway, built and rolled out across the TDK Group. Provides secure, authenticated generative AI (with internal SQL servers for privacy) and enables scalable deployment of agentic AI solutions for employees. [TDK GenAI (in-house platform)]

TDK Talent Hub GenAI HR pilot — a domain-knowledge generative-AI pilot with a 3-module upskilling journey to help HR teams learn, apply and scale generative AI responsibly, reshaping how HR teams work. [TDK GenAI]
TDK Generative AI (TDK GenAI): Enterprise Generative AI Service Platform

Agentic AI for CRM — TDK describes deploying agentic AI (built on the TDK GenAI platform and API gateway) to transform CRM systems into an intelligent growth engine, powered by AI and data integration for sales/customer functions. [TDK GenAI (agentic AI)]
